kpis.description_fr: Corporate = grandes entreprises USA. Plus gros segment CDW. Cycle IT B2B faible 2023-24, recovery progressive.
kpis.description_en: Corporate = large US enterprise. CDW's largest segment. Weak 2023-24 IT B2B cycle, gradual recovery.

kpis.description_fr: Small Business = PME USA. Cyclique macroéconomie. Subi pression 2024.
kpis.description_en: Small Business = US SMBs. Cyclical on macroeconomy. Pressured in 2024.

kpis.description_fr: Public = gouvernement + éducation + santé. Plus stable que Corporate. Croissance soutenue post-pandémie (digitalisation).
kpis.description_en: Public = government + education + healthcare. More stable than Corporate. Sustained growth post-pandemic (digitization).

kpis.description_fr: Activités UK + Canada. Petits par rapport au USA mais croissance régulière. Acquisitions Sirius (USA) + Misco UK/Canada Q3 2021.
kpis.description_en: UK + Canada operations. Small vs USA but steady growth. Acquired Sirius (USA) + Misco UK/Canada Q3 2021.

kpis.description_fr: Services & Software ~12 % vs ~88 % hardware. Mix shift voulu vers services (marges 3-4x supérieures).
kpis.description_en: Services & Software ~12% vs ~88% hardware. Desired mix shift toward services (3-4x higher margins).
